answer: Divergence-challenge ledger: Coordinator periodically samples agents and requires each to extend a random walk from its local atlas using a private per-agent seed, publishing only the resulting hash. Distinct histories yield uncorrelated ripples; clones cannot diverge, so their hashes collide. Collisions above a nadir threshold quarantine all linked accounts. Attacker cost: unique seed and execution state per clone plus losing entire colliding clusters, not just one account.
